title: AUDIT-20 finding record
description: findings.json is an ARRAY of these; FOUNDATION_AUDIT.md is GENERATED from it so the two cannot drift. Canonical source: 01-RESEARCH.md Architecture Patterns, Pattern 3. Ids are stable and are NEVER renumbered, even when a finding is withdrawn.

id.description: Stable id, zero-padded to three digits.

severity.description: Exposure-adjusted per SEVERITY_SLA.md. CVSS vectors are not assigned to application-logic findings.

affected_paths.description: Every Critical and High must carry at least one entry WITH line numbers.

lines.description: A line or line range, for example 168-175. Null is permitted only on Medium and Low.

evidence.description: A path RELATIVE TO .planning/audit/ that must resolve to an existing file, optionally with a fragment. NEVER an inline literal, because inline evidence is how a cookie or connection string reaches git history.

expiry.description: At most ninety days after date. An expired acceptance reverts status to Open automatically, asserted by validate.mjs --check findings.

rationale.description: Must make a reachability argument, not a convenience argument.

resolution.description: OPTIONAL. Added in Phase 2 (plan 02-11) because the register had nowhere to say HOW a finding closed. When a later phase changes status or closes_in_phase, the note says what was done, in which commit, and what evidence proves it — and, when the closure is partial, exactly which clause did NOT close. gen-foundation-audit.mjs renders it as a Resolution paragraph; absent on a finding that has never been touched since Phase 1.
